notes: Azahar (Nintendo 3DS): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of Azahar 2126.1.2 (SDL2 2.32.10 linked in).
-f: fullscreen; the last argument is the game, booted at once (no game list).

Azahar never quits when a game stops: Select + Start is its own 'Exit Azahar' shortcut (qt-config.ini), which quits cleanly with confirmClose off, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back. SIGTERM ends it at once, no dialog.
Only decrypted .3ds/.cci/.cxi/.3dsx (and Azahar's compressed z* forms) are listed: a .cia must be installed first (Azahar asks in a dialog).
gui_args: Azahar's own window and game list (touch screen; no pad-driven UI). Select + Start quits it too.

Dual-screen boards (device-env RETROFORGE_SECONDARY_CONNECTOR set): qt-config-dual-screen.ini is seeded instead, with layout_option=4 (separate windows): the 'Secondary Window' goes to the second panel by its title (gamescope patch 0041).

SDL_NO_SIGNAL_HANDLERS=1: Azahar's SDL (pads, audio) otherwise catches SIGTERM and turns it into an SDL quit event Azahar never reads (its loop is Qt's), so OpenGamepadUI's Exit did nothing and a second Exit SIGKILLed the whole tree, launcher and mount included (HW 2026-10-12, Thor Lite: SigCgt had SIGTERM). With the hint SIGTERM keeps its default action and ends Azahar at once, as RPCS3's same fix.
